description: Branch Bar — 统一 worktree status 可视化 + rebase 操作

tasks.title: Add getWorktreeStatus to WorktreeManager
tasks.description: Add a `getWorktreeStatus()` method to `WorktreeManager` in `packages/cli/src/git/worktree-manager.ts` that returns `{ exists, branch, baseBranch, ahead, behind, rebaseInProgress, conflictingFiles }`. Use `git rev-list --left-right --count <baseBranch>...<branch>` for ahead/behind, existing `isRebaseInProgress()` for rebase state, and `getConflictingFiles()` for conflict list. Also add the `WorktreeStatus` interface export.
acceptanceCriteria: WorktreeManager has a getWorktreeStatus(projectPath, projectName, issueNumber, baseBranch) async method
Method returns WorktreeStatus with exists, branch, baseBranch, ahead, behind, rebaseInProgress, conflictingFiles
When worktree does not exist, returns { exists: false }
When worktree exists, ahead/behind are parsed from git rev-list output
rebaseInProgress uses existing isRebaseInProgress() method
conflictingFiles populated only when rebaseInProgress is true
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The private getConflictingFiles method already exists at line 357. Make it accessible (either make public or reuse logic inline).

tasks.title: Add worktree-status API endpoint
tasks.description: Add `GET /:number/worktree-status` route to `packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts`. Place it alongside other sub-resource GET routes (near `GET /:number/diff` around line 1220). Hono uses Trie-based routing so order does not matter. The handler validates project context, finds the issue, gets project baseBranch, and delegates to `worktreeManager.getWorktreeStatus()`. Returns standard ApiResponse envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/worktree-status returns { success: true, data: WorktreeStatus } when worktree exists
Returns { success: true, data: { exists: false } } when worktree does not exist
Returns 404 when issue not found
Returns 400 when no active project
Route is registered alongside other /:number sub-resource routes (after GET /:number)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the exact pattern of the existing GET /:number/diff endpoint (lines 1220-1294) for route handler structure. Hono uses Trie-based routing, so /:number/worktree-status can be placed alongside other /:number/* routes regardless of order.

tasks.title: Create BranchBar component
tasks.spec: specs/branch-bar/spec.md#BranchBar-组件提供统一的分支状态可视化
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/components/BranchBar.tsx`. Self-contained component with props `{ issueNumber, stage, isAgentRunning }`. Internally uses `useWorktreeStatus` hook and owns its own `useMutation` for rebase via `api.rebaseIssue()`. Three visual states: synced (transparent bg, green 'up to date'), behind (amber-50 bg, rebase button), rebasing (blue bg, spinner). Returns null when worktree doesn't exist or stage is Backlog/Explore. Invalidates worktree-status query on mutation completion.
acceptanceCriteria: BranchBar renders branch name (mo/issue-N), ahead/behind counts, baseBranch name
synced state: transparent background, green 'up to date' text, no rebase button
behind state: amber-50 background, amber accents, shows 'Rebase onto {baseBranch}' button
rebasing state: blue background, spinner, 'Rebasing...' text, no button
conflict state: red accent with conflictingFiles list
Returns null when data.exists is false
Returns null for Backlog/Explore stages
Rebase button disabled when isAgentRunning is true
Mutation invalidates ['issues', issueNumber, 'worktree-status'] query on settle
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the same spinner SVG pattern from IssueDetailPage.tsx. Use useQueryClient().invalidateQueries for post-mutation refresh. Import Stage enum from lib/types.
